title: Configuration layer with audited thresholds
objective: Centralize settings in Pydantic Settings with thresholds loaded from config, never hardcoded, with change history recorded.
agent_steps: Implement config.py: env-prefixed TRACEAI_, typed fields, .env support.
Load text_block_threshold (0.85) and image_block_threshold (0.90) from config only.
Add a thresholds history table migration stub in Postgres for audited changes.
Forbid literals: add a ruff rule that flags 0.85/0.90 outside config/tests.
acceptance_criteria: Changing TRACEAI_TEXT_BLOCK_THRESHOLD changes behavior without code edits.
grep confirms no threshold literals outside config, tests, and docs.
Doctor command reports effective thresholds and their config source.
